name: scene3d_patch_object_keyframes
description: Retime or re-pose existing object keyframes by id, and/or flip autoOrient on a track. Only the fields you send change. Rotation in degrees. Ids from scene3d_state (scope cameraPath). @see guides_get('scene3d')

poses.description: Keyframes to patch. Unsent fields keep their stored value.

easing.description: Easing INTO this pose: smooth | linear | ease-in | ease-out | ease-in-out.

tracks.description: Flip whether an object turns to face its direction of travel.
